newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jordan's Hussein to West Bank with Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's Hussein to West Bank with Arafat.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein will travel to the West Bank on Tuesday with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, a senior PLO official said.
"King Hussein is returning to Jericho with Arafat where they will hold a meeting on Tuesday," the PLO official told Reuters.
King Hussein has not visited the West Bank since Israel seized the territory from Jordan in the 1967 Middle East war.
The PLO official said U.S.-brokered peace talks, slated to resume in Egypt's Red Sea resort of Taba, would not convene on Tuesday as planned.
"The Israelis and Palestinians will not be meeting in Taba on Tuesday," the official said. Israeli officials were not immediately available to confirm the delay.
The formal Taba talks were to have resumed on Monday but were pushed back to allow the sides to progress in informal negotiation channels.
